newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Comalco shares dip after year loss.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Comalco shares dip after year loss.

text.p: The shares of bauxite, alumina and aluminium miner, Comalco Ltd opened weaker on Monday after the company reported a joint venture net loss of A$16.8 million for calendar 1996.
At 10.50 a.m (2350 GMT), Comalco shares were seven cents weaker at A$6.75 on turnover of just 11,475 shares.
Comalco said its pre-abnormal net profit for the 1996 year was A$32.9 million, a fraction of the A$264.9 million it earned in 1995.
The company said its earning were hit by the combination of lower metal prices and a stronger Australian dollar.

Comalco reported a gross abnormal loss of A$115 million in the period which reflected the closure of its kaolin business and costs associated with sale of Australian and New Zealand downstream operations and restructuring costs.
"There's a bit of support for the stock at A$6.75 and there dosen't seem to be much selling around," a Brisbane dealer said.
"The market has pretty much factored in the loss and is now focusing future earnings prospects," he said.
Comalco Ltd is about 67 percent owned by RTZ Corp CRA Ltd group.
